Secondary sources

Bartlett, R.H.. Indian Reserves in Quebec. Saskatoon: University of Saskatchewan. Native Law Centre, 1984.

Beta. A Contribution to a Proper Understanding of the Oka Question; and a help to its equitable and speedy settlement. Montreal: Pamphlet 1879. Sourced archive.org

Frideres, J.S.. Native People in Canada. Scarborough: Prentice-Hall, 1983.

Jaenen, Cornelius J.. The French Relationship with the Native Peoples of New France and Acadia. Ottawa: Indian Affairs and Northern Development, 1984. (Retrieved from Government of Canada Publications, October 2021.)

MacLeod, D. Peter, The Canadian Iroquois and the Seven Years War. Co-published by the Canadian War Museum and Dundurn Press Toronto, 2012.

Richter, Daniel K.. The Ordeal of the Longhouse. Chapel Hill: University of North Carolina Press and Omohundro Institute of Early American History and Culture, 1992.

Surtees, R. Indian Land Surrenders in Ontario 1763-18678. Ottawa: Indian Affairs and Northern Development, 1984. (Retrieved from Government of Canada Publications, October 2021.)
